VisiumCaptureArea.description: Area (or Capture Area) - One of the either four or two active regions where tissue can be placed on a Visium slide. Each area is intended to contain only one tissue sample. Slide areas are named consecutively from top to bottom: A1, B1, C1, D1 for Visium slides with 6.5 mm Capture Area and A, B for CytAssist slides with 11 mm Capture Area. Both CytAssist slides with 6.5 mm Capture Area and Gateway Slides contain only two slide areas, A1 and D1.
VisiumCaptureArea.title: Visium Capture Area

VisiumImageRe-orientation.description: To ensure good fiducial alignment and tissue spots detection, it is important to correct for this shift in orientation.
VisiumImageRe-orientation.title: Visium Image Re-orientation

VisiumPermeabilizationTime.description: Fixed and stained tissue sections are permeabilized for different times. Each Capture Area captures polyadenylated mRNA from the attached tissue section. Measure is provided in minutes.
VisiumPermeabilizationTime.title: Visium Permeabilization Time

VisiumRNALevel1Id.description: Unique row identifier, used as a primary key for record updates. This should be equivalent to the file Synapse Id unless otherwise indicated.

VisiumRunID.description: A unique identifier for this individual run (typically associated with a single slide) of the spatial transcriptomic processing workflow.
VisiumRunID.title: Visium Run ID

VisiumSlideID.description: For Visium, it is the unique identifier printed on the label of each Visium slide. The serial number starts with V followed by a number which can range between one through five and ends with a dash and a three digit number, such as 123. For CosMx, this refers to the loaded Flow Cell ID. For Xenium, this ID indicates the slide orientation, as it matches the relative location of the ID on the physical Xenium slide.
VisiumSlideID.title: Visium Slide ID

VisiumSlideVersion.description: Version of imaging slide used. Slide version is critical for the analysis of the sequencing data as different slides have different capture area layouts.
VisiumSlideVersion.title: Visium Slide Version

VisiumSpatialLibraryConstructionMethod.description: Process which results in the creation of a library from fragments of DNA using cloning vectors or oligonucleotides with the role of adaptors [OBI_0000711]
VisiumSpatialLibraryConstructionMethod.title: Visium Spatial Library Construction Method
